name: 2layer-low-speed
description: Rigid FR4, two copper layers, low-speed digital and low-current power. Full automation is permitted: build, place, autoroute, DRC, DFM and fabrication export.
notes: The default 2-layer stackup is a generic 1.6 mm FR4 core; confirm it with the fabricator.
Full automation is only claimed when DRC, unconnected and DFM gates all pass.
This profile is not for controlled impedance, RF, high voltage, flex or safety-critical designs.
